main_text.p: שָׁפַךְ Fudit, Effudit. Niphal נִשְׁפַּךְ Effusus fuit. Pyhal שִׁפֵּךְ Idem. Hithpahel הִשְׁתַּפֵּךְ Effundi, Effundere se.

שָׁפַל Humilem, Demissum, Submissum, Deiectum, Depressum esse, Deprimi, Humiliari. Hiphil הִשְׁפִּיל Humiliavit, Demisit, Dejecit, Depressit: Demisit se. Sic Chald. הִשְׁפַּלְתְּ Depressisti, Daniel. 5.22. Partic. Praesens. מַשְׁפִּיל Deprimebat, v. 9. Infin. לְהַשְׁפָּלָה Humiliare, Daniel. 4.34. Fut. יַשְׁפִּיל Deprimet, Dan. 7.24.
שָׁפָל, שְׁפַל m. Humilis, Demissus, Submissus, Dejectus. Abjectus, Depressus: plur. שְׁפָלִים. Fœm. sing. שְׁפָלָה.
שָׁפָן שָׁפָן m. Cuniculus, vel juxta alios, Mus montanus: plur. שְׁפָנִים.
